tasks.title: Conversation #49
tasks.transcript:
Man: Check out these photos I took at the game last night. What do you think for a first attempt?
Woman: Well, they're a little bit blurry. I'm not really sure what I'm looking at.
Man: Oh, I suppose you're right. I really need to improve my photography skills.
Woman: Why don't you join the photography club? We're happy to have members of all experience levels.
Man: Have you found it helpful?
Woman: You've seen the pictures from my vacation.

questions.stem: What can be concluded about the man's photos?

options.A: They were published in a newspaper.
options.B: They are good for a first attempt.
options.C: They are not of high quality.

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 关于男士的照片可以得出什么结论？属于细节理解题。 定位原文：Woman: Well, they're a little bit blurry. I'm not really sure what I'm looking at. 选项分析: A. They were published in a newspaper. (它们被刊登在报纸上了。) - 错误。对话中未提及照片被发表。 B. They are good for a first attempt. (作为初次尝试它们很不错。) - 错误。男士虽然问“作为初次尝试怎么样？”，但女士的回答表明照片并不好。 C. They are not of high quality. (它们的质量不高。) - 正确。女士提到照片“a little bit blurry”（有点模糊）且她“not really sure what I'm looking at”（不太确定看的是什么），说明照片质量不高。 D. They were taken last week. (它们是上周拍的。) - 错误。男士明确说是“last night”（昨晚）拍的。

questions.stem: What does the woman imply when she says,"You've seen the pictures from my vacation"?

options.A: The photography club has helped her improve her skills.
options.C: She enjoys taking pictures of sunsets.
options.D: She generally does not show the man pictures she has taken.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士说“你看过我假期的照片了”时暗示了什么？属于推断题。 定位原文：Man: Have you found it helpful? Woman: You've seen the pictures from my vacation. 选项分析：A. The photography club has helped her improve her skills. 摄影俱乐部帮助她提高了技能。由于男士询问俱乐部是否有帮助，女士没有直接回答，而是让男士参考她假期拍出的好照片，暗示是俱乐部帮助她提升了水平，所以 A 选项正确。 B. Her vacation was particularly long. 她的假期特别长。因为对话讨论的是照片质量，与假期长短无关，所以 B 选项错误。 C. She enjoys taking pictures of sunsets. 她喜欢拍日落的照片。因为对话中并未提及具体的拍摄对象是日落，所以 C 选项错误。 D. She generally does not show the man pictures she has taken. 她通常不给男士看她拍的照片。因为对话中没有涉及她是否经常分享照片的习惯，所以 D 选项错误。
